reviews.text: Not the first ph changing blush and not the best.. colour is extremely subtle on my skin tone
reviews.zh: 唔係第一隻 ph 變色胭脂，亦唔算最好嘅⋯⋯上到我塊面，顏色淡到不得了

reviews.text:
For reference : I'm shade 19-21 and am the summer mute type
This blush is sooo cute! It's also very buildable so you can wear it as a cute natural tone or quite easily build it up to look more more vibrant and give a flushed look. A lot of more western blushes say this but are then very difficult to control and easily become too much (a dot makes half the face red..) but this blush somehow is soo easy to control the amount of and can be whatever you want it to be honestly.
I got the shade C02 Blueberry Chip and was a little worried it'd be too light or wash me out but that's not the case at all! It's a cool toned pink but doesn't have harsh purple or bright pink tones to make it seem unnatural on the face, which is an issue I've encountered a lot.
It does seem to have a blurring effect which would definitely be a pro for those with oily skin or visible pores!
The photo shows the blush at it's brightest with quite a few layers!
reviews.zh:
參考：我用 19-21 號色，屬於 summer mute 類型
呢隻胭脂超超超得意！亦都好容易層叠，你可以化到可愛自然嘅效果，亦都可以輕易疊加到更鮮明、有紅暈感嘅妝感。好多西方品牌嘅胭脂都話可以咁，但好難控制份量，好容易落太多（一點就已經成塊面紅晒⋯⋯），但呢隻胭脂就可以好容易控制份量，老實講你想要咩效果都可以做到。
我揀咗 C02 Blueberry Chip 呢個色號，本來有少少擔心會太淺或者會令我成塊面變晒白，但完全唔係咁回事！係冷調嘅粉紅色，但冇嗰種太紫或者太鮮粉紅嘅感覺，所以唔會喺塊面望落好假呢一點我成日都遇到。
佢的確有少少 blur 毛孔嘅效果，對於油性肌或者毛孔明顯嘅人嚟講絕對係優點！
張相係胭脂上到最明顯嘅狀態，layer 咗幾層！

reviews.text: romand blushes are known to be very subtle, but the new spring fever blushes (lychee chip) is veryyyy light. I feel like I have to really layer it on for it to show up on my cheek even just a little bit😭 it’s a gorgeous shade don’t get me wrong, but girl im going to hit the pan before it shows up on my face /hj
reviews.zh: romand 嘅胭脂一向出名好淡，但新款 spring fever 胭脂（lychee chip）就真係超超超淡。我覺得我要不停 layer 先可以喺塊面有少少顯色😭 唔係話佢個色唔靚，個色真係好靚，但姊妹我覺得我塊面仲未上到色，個胭脂已經見底 /hj

reviews.text:
I'm not extremely pale but I'm not very tanned either (half chinese) and Vine Nude does show up on my cheeks but it's very sheer, not as sheer as Nutty Nude was (that basically was almost my skin color & disappeared). I went ahead and got Blueberry Chip hoping that color is a little more apparent.

So if you're super pale & want a pretty blurring pink blush Vine Nude is perfect
reviews.zh:
我唔算極白但都唔算好黝黑（半個中國人），Vine Nude 喺我塊面係有顯色，但非常通透，未至於好似 Nutty Nude 嗰隻咁透明（嗰隻基本上同我膚色一樣，直接消失咗）。所以我特登去咗攞 Blueberry Chip，希望嗰隻色可以更加明顯。

所以如果係超白又想要一隻靚嘅 blur 感粉紅胭脂，Vine Nude 就啱晒

reviews.text: Honestly at first I thought this would not show up on my skin or even look good on my skin as it looked very white and chalky when I first swatched it. However once on the skin I could see why people who are Summer Mute loved this shade. It is more muted and more pigmented on the skin and I loved how much it complemented my skin. The photo made it look more pale and white in comparison to real life so please put that into consideration.
reviews.zh: 老實講，一開始我以為呢隻胭脂喺我塊面會唔顯色，甚至望落唔會好睇，因為一試色嗰陣望落好白好粉。但搽上塊面之後我終於明白點解 Summer Mute 嘅人會咁鍾意呢隻色。上咗塊面之後會更加 muted，亦更加顯色，我好鍾意佢點樣襯我嘅膚色。張相比起實際睇起嚟更加白同淡，請大家考慮埋呢一點。

reviews.text: It looks white and chalky on my fingers but I promise it goes on so naturally. Just the slightest wash of color on my skin. Compared to the clio shadow gallery palette blush it’s much more neutral. Brush is on the smaller side but perfect for how I like to apply blush. You really can’t tell what the color will be like based on the swatch.
reviews.zh: 手指上試色嘅時候望落白蒙蒙好似粉筆灰咁，但我可以保證，搽上面就超自然。喺我塊面只係留低最輕微嘅顏色。對比 clio shadow gallery 嘅胭脂，呢隻更加中性。刷頭偏細，但就啱我鍾意嘅胭脂上妝方式。單靠試色真係完全睇唔到上塊面嘅效果。

reviews.text:
The reformulation of rom&nd's blushes has really improved the formula. There is much less fallout now and the application feels softer, more even and the blurred effect is even better.
Nutty Nude is a soft yellow beige shade that works well by itself or as a base for layering blusher. 
I'd recommend buying this even just for the brush as it's really high quality and the perfect size.
reviews.zh:
rom&nd 胭脂嘅新配方真係改良咗好多。飛粉少咗好多，上色感覺更加柔軟、更加均勻，blur 毛孔嘅效果亦更加好。
Nutty Nude 係一個柔和嘅黃米色色號，單用或者做胭脂 base 嚟 layer 上面都好好用。
就算淨係為咗支刷我都會推薦大家買，支刷真係好高質又啱用。

reviews.text: Love the formula of the new blushes! I have a muted neutral/Olive undertone (use cushion 23-25) and surprisingly Vine Nude is more cooler and lavender/purple than I thought! It has a white base but is easy to build up without looking chalky on my skin! I think up to a medium skin tone can use it. I love the new formula. It’s very smooth and so easy to blend. It blurs your skin and there is barely any powder fallout compared to the original! I do miss the cute heart designs on the previous versions though as it’s much cuter. Hope they can bring out more colours and maybe bring back the cute heart print on the packaging. Highly recommend these!
reviews.zh: 新胭脂嘅配方真係好正！我係 muted neutral／Olive 底調（用 cushion 23-25 號），出乎意料地 Vine Nude 比我想像中更加冷調同更加薰衣草／紫色！佢有白色 base，但容易 layer，唔會喺我塊面望落粉感太重！我覺得中等膚色都用得到。我好鍾意新配方。超滑順又好容易推開。可以 blur 毛孔，比起舊版幾乎完全冇飛粉！不過我真係好掛住之前嗰啲得意嘅心心 pattern，因為可愛好多。希望佢哋可以出多啲顏色，可能仲可以將嗰個得意心心印花帶返包裝。極度推薦！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
